root.label: Ballinas government claim against Anaheim mayor Aitken released

events.label: Ballinas government claim against Anaheim mayor Aitken released

slots.name: claim length
slots.sentence: Anaheim Mayor Ashleigh Aitken has been accused of repeatedly appearing intoxicated during city-related events, making racially derogatory remarks and asking intrusive questions about sexuality, according to a newly released 25-page government claim.

slots.name: review status
slots.sentence: Anaheim has said a review of the allegations is underway.

slots.name: date of impaired city council meeting
slots.sentence: She alleges that Aitken arrived at a City Council meeting in April 2025 appearing "visibly impaired by alcohol."

slots.name: denial of racial slur usage
slots.sentence: Aitken has directly denied using the racial slur attributed to her and said the allegations deserve to be investigated.

slots.name: start date of forced leave
slots.sentence: The government claim says Ballinas was forced to take leave beginning around July 31 and alleges retaliation after she reported or opposed conduct she believed violated laws or workplace rules.
